9. FormibPDF (in-house Rust engine) and its Rust dependencies
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FormibPDF is developed by B&B Creations and statically linked.
It depends on the following crates (all dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 unless
noted); license text for Apache-2.0 is in licenses/apache-2.0.txt:
    rayon    (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
    flate2   (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
    fontdue  (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
    image    (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
    lcms2    (MIT) — Rust binding to Little-CMS (MIT, see licenses/lcms.txt)

================================================================================
  Notes
================================================================================
* This notice covers the TorReader PDF (Windows x64) distribution. The Linux
  AppImage ships the same components except OpenSSL (digital signature support
  is not built on Linux).
* Translation and AI features send only the text you explicitly select to the
  configured online service (Google Translate / Google Gemini). No document is
  uploaded automatically. See privacy.html on torreader.cloud.
* This file is provided for attribution and license-compliance purposes. It is
  not legal advice.
